result.summary: The image shows a wide, car-oriented intersection adjacent to commercial land use. While a marked crosswalk is visible, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a very wide expanse without any mid-point refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background at the marked crosswalk across the main arterial.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching across the middle of the image.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, featuring a wide multi-lane arterial road with a signalized intersection that lacks marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. The design prioritizes high-speed vehicle movement, resulting in long, unprotected crossing distances and poor visibility for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No signals are visible to provide dedicated crossing time or information for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: This is a high-speed, multi-lane arterial intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, signals, or refuge islands. The environment is heavily car-oriented with extremely long crossing distances and no physical protection for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this large intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path or legal priority.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to high-speed traffic for a long duration without any mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the foreground roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible to indicate safe crossing intervals, leaving pedestrians to guess based on vehicle lights.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised concrete islands in the center of the roadway to reduce exposure and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and push-button activation.
